purpose: A second set of repos, kept apart from bench/repos.json, for changing and checking the detectors. None of these repos is in the benchmark set or in docs/tested-on-real-projects.md. Use the tune group to change detectors and the validate group only to check the result, so a change is never measured on the repos it was made on.
rule: Group sizes come from the detector's extract() for counting only. A repo is usable only if it has a group the detector can report on: 20 or more routes in one folder, or 20 or more CI jobs.
finding: Most permissively licensed FastAPI projects fail that floor. Of 19 candidates cloned, three have a folder with 20 or more routes, and two have 20 or more CI jobs. The set is small because the detector's own floor excludes most projects.
